connection_fields.name: driver
connection_fields.description: the protocol: http (the default) or native, ClickHouse's own TCP protocol

connection_fields.name: port
connection_fields.description: server port (default 8123, 8443 with secure, 9000 native, 9440 native with secure)

connection_fields.name: schema
connection_fields.description: the ClickHouse database to use (dbt's name; `database` also works)

connection_fields.name: secure
connection_fields.description: connect with TLS (ClickHouse Cloud needs it)

connection_fields.name: ca_cert
connection_fields.description: CA certificate to trust for the server's TLS certificate (PEM), when it isn't from a public CA

connection_fields.name: server_host_name
connection_fields.description: the host name to expect on the server's TLS certificate, when it isn't `host`

connection_fields.name: connect_timeout
connection_fields.description: how long to wait for a connection (`30s`, `2m`, or seconds)

connection_fields.name: send_receive_timeout
connection_fields.description: how long to wait on a read or write to the server (`5m`, or seconds)

connection_fields.name: compression
connection_fields.description: how results are compressed on the wire: lz4 (the default), zstd, none, or for http gzip, deflate or br

connection_fields.name: custom_settings
connection_fields.description: ClickHouse settings for every query, e.g. max_execution_time: 300

connection_fields.name: retries
connection_fields.description: how many times to try connecting again after a temporary error (0: never)

connection_fields.name: ssh
connection_fields.description: reach the server through an SSH bastion (a block of settings)
